author: The Babylon Bee
description: Computer renderings offer a first look at the proposed Donald J. Trump Presidential Library, which promises to be the most beautiful thing you'll ever see. This digital art presentation showcases a stunning architectural design, complete with a reflecting pool filled with 'liberal tears.' The rendering provides a detailed glimpse into the iconic vision for this presidential library.
title: Trump Presidential Library To Feature Solemn 'Reflecting Pool' Of Liberal Tears

author: The Babylon Bee
description: In a new milestone for Major League Baseball, every single inning of a game was aired on a different streaming platform.
title: Every Inning Of Baseball Game Aired On Different Streaming Service
